feature_version: aligned_50; text_bert re-encoded consistently using frozen bert-base-uncased
checkpoint_selection: Selected best calibrated single model from the completed prior validation search; user chose single-model deployment.
fixed_protocol_note: Specified before fitting. No selection from attachment 3/4 or test labels. Standardization fits train only. Zero rows in A/V treated as unavailable, without claiming their cause. UNK token 100 in attachment 3 treated as unavailable text; original arrays never modified.
text_corruption: Before frozen BERT, replace unavailable wordpiece IDs with UNK 100; re-encode remaining contextual vectors. Six deterministic training view banks, sampled per example each epoch. The same perturbation is used across all model ablations.
classification_reporting: class probability argmax after fixed validation-selected bias; raw regression intensity unchanged
prior_test_exposure: The original study already reported test outcomes. This is a revised experiment on the same split, not a newly untouched test. No test-dependent selection in this revision.
q3_training: Not part of this Q2-only experiment.

bias_search.selection: highest complete validation correct count, then macro-F1, then smallest squared bias norm, then lowest MAE
bias_search.negative_only_control: same grid with neutral and positive biases zero
bias_search.scope: calibrated-best and raw-accuracy-best checkpoint per seed over 20 epochs; all single seeds and same-config 3-seed equal-probability ensembles; previous A4 checkpoints also candidates
bias_search.interpretation: decision-boundary calibration, not a claim of calibrated confidence probabilities
